## Cuándo usar cada herramienta de conteo

<div class="mt-20">
<table class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1" style="font-size: 32px; width: 105%; border-collapse: collapse;">
<tr style="background:#3b82f6; color:white;">
<th class="pad-8">Situación</th>
<th class="pad-8">¿Orden importa?</th>
<th class="pad-8">¿Repetición?</th>
<th class="pad-8">Herramienta</th>
</tr>
<tr style="background:#f3f4f6;">
<td class="pad-8">Ordenar $n$ objetos distintos</td>
<td class="pad-8">Sí</td>
<td class="pad-8">No</td>
<td class="pad-8">$n!$</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8">Elegir y ordenar $r$ de $n$</td>
<td class="pad-8">Sí</td>
<td class="pad-8">No</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(n,r)$</td>
</tr>
<tr style="background:#f3f4f6;">
<td class="pad-8">Ordenar con grupos repetidos</td>
<td class="pad-8">Sí</td>
<td class="pad-8">Sí</td>
<td class="pad-8">$\frac{n!}{n_1!\cdots n_k!}$</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8">Elegir $r$ de $n$ sin orden</td>
<td class="pad-8">No</td>
<td class="pad-8">No</td>
<td class="pad-8">$\binom{n}{r}$</td>
</tr>
<tr style="background:#f3f4f6;">
<td class="pad-8">Etapas independientes</td>
<td class="pad-8">,</td>
<td class="pad-8">,</td>
<td class="pad-8">Principio multiplicativo</td>
</tr>
</table>
